author: bdanzi
body:
#### PR description:

This PR implements what was needed for running the full offline tracking LST+mkFit configuration in the [last presentation](https://indico.cern.ch/event/1728251/contributions/7279058/attachments/3346870/5999995/Phase%202%20offline%20with%20mkFit%20and%20LST.pdf) at the tracking POG by @bucket420 with and without JetCore tracking iteration. PR does not need externals, but it could also be exploited to test https://github.com/cms-data/RecoTracker-MkFit/pull/23 . New Phase-2 workflows `.716` (CPU) and `.717` (GPU) has been added to test the full offline reconstruction with the full Phase-2 offline tracking developments.

The PR introduces the following changes:
1. in `iterativeTkConfig.py`: `JetCoreRegionalStep` is appended only once to the Phase-2 iteration list (also with `trackingIters01`).
   - Before, it was appended twice: the reconstruction ran, but the tracking validation failed at configuration time (`Duplicate InputTag in labels: cutsRecoTracksJetCoreRegionalStep` in `MultiTrackValidator`), e.g. in the Phase-2 `_JetCore` workflows (`.19002`).
2. `InitialStepPreSplitting_cff.py`: adapt the `trackingMkFitInitialStepPreSplitting` for Phase-2, the mkFit pre-splitting initialStep iteration now uses the Phase-2 OT hits (`siPhase2RecHits` + `mkFitSiPhase2Hits`) and `mkfit-phase2-initialStep.json`.
   - Before, it used the SiStrip hits from Run 3 and the job failed (`ProductNotFound` for `siStripMatchedRecHits`). So LST+mkFit could not run with JetCore for offline tracking - JetCore needs pre-splitting tracking iteration to run.
3. `earlyGeneralTracks_cfi.py`: with `trackingLST`, the merge set is now renumbered instead of having an element deleted, so the LST+mkFit tracks are hit-share cleaned against the other iterations, with or without JetCore.
   - The LST tracks are not cleaned among themselves (`indivShareFrac = 1.0`), since that removes genuine tracks in dense jet cores.
4. `LowPtQuadStep_cff.py`: with `trackingLST`, all the hits of the LST tracks are masked for `lowPtQuadStep` (`maxChi2 = 1e3`), including those with a large chi2 increment.
   - Before, `lowPtQuadStep` re-found part of the LST tracks.
5. `InitialStepPreSplitting_cff.py`: tighter pre-splitting seeding proposed by @bucket420. With `splitClustersInPhase2Pixel`, the seed layers are restricted to 7 pixel quadruplet combinations, and the region `ptMin` goes from 0.6 to 3.2 GeV.
   - The pre-splitting only finds the jet cores for the cluster splitting, so this speeds it up without changing the physics performance.
6. `Configuration/PyReleaseValidation`: new Phase-2 workflows `.716` (CPU) and `.717` (GPU): LST+mkFit with all iterations including JetCore, full reco, as `.714`/`.715` plus `jetCoreInPhase2,splitClustersInPhase2Pixel,trackingMkFitInitialStepPreSplitting`. `.716` is added to the IB short matrix (`relval_Run4.py`) and `.717` to `relval_gpu.py`.

Changes 1-4 are fixes; change 5-6 is an optimization/addition:

| Changes | Effect |
|---|---|
| 1 and 2 | make LST+mkFit with JetCore (and its validation) runnable |
| 3 and 4 | reduce the LST+mkFit fake and duplicate rates (about 20%) without compromising reconstruction efficiency when running all the offline tracking iterations, also without JetCore |
| 5 | reduces the time of every tracking offline configuration that runs JetCore with `splitClustersInPhase2Pixel` |
| 6 | adds the new workflows with JetCore, full reco, with best efficiency for offline tracking

Configurations without these procModifiers are unchanged.
None of the changes affects `trackingIters01` without JetCore.

#### PR validation:

Setup: `CMSSW_20_1_X_2026-10-27-2300` with an updated offline LST-step mkFit JSON, the first version of [cms-data/RecoTracker-MkFit#23](https://github.com/cms-data/RecoTracker-MkFit/pull/23) (first commit e88cb92: pixel-priority duplicate cleaner, dc_drth = 0 and backward-fit outlier rejection). The fixes act after mkFit, on the merge and the masking, so their effect does not depend on the JSON: with the offline JSON of the release the reduction of fakes and duplicates is the same. 

- LST+mkFit, all iterations, without JetCore (`CMSSW`, `LST`, `LST_thisPR`): [QCD Pt 1800-2400, PU200, 500 events](http://uaf-3.t2.ucsd.edu/~bdanzi/Phase2Offline/PRTests_52011_52015_JetCore_20261008/qcd/17_fixesPR_IB27/plots_ootb/effandfakePtEtaPhi.pdf), [TTbar, PU200, 500 events](http://uaf-3.t2.ucsd.edu/~bdanzi/Phase2Offline/PRTests_52011_52015_JetCore_20261008/ttbar/17_fixesPR_IB27/plots_ootb/effandfakePtEtaPhi.pdf)
- LST+mkFit, all iterations, with JetCore (`CMSSWJC`, `LSTJC_before` = only changes 1+2 are included, `LSTJC_thisPR` = all changes included): [QCD Pt 1800-2400, PU200, 500 events](http://uaf-3.t2.ucsd.edu/~bdanzi/Phase2Offline/PRTests_52011_52015_JetCore_20261008/qcd/19_fixesPR_IB27_JetCore_all/plots_ootb/effandfakePtEtaPhi.pdf), [TTbar, PU200, 500 events](http://uaf-3.t2.ucsd.edu/~bdanzi/Phase2Offline/PRTests_52011_52015_JetCore_20261008/ttbar/19_fixesPR_IB27_JetCore_all/plots_ootb/effandfakePtEtaPhi.pdf)

#### Backport
no
